veranderings.voor: Die klip met die goud in vorm 'n dun laag
veranderings.na: Die klip waarin die goud sit, vorm 'n dun laag
veranderings.rede: 'met die goud in vorm' reads awkwardly and can be misparsed as 'in vorm'; the relative clause is clearer and matches the glossary entry for rif.

veranderings.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf
veranderings.voor: Myners breek die klip los en masjiene
veranderings.na: Myners breek die klip los, en masjiene
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Van die klip tot 'n suiwer staaf
veranderings.voor: goud ook as suiwer stawe en Suid-Afrika
veranderings.na: goud ook as suiwer stawe, en Suid-Afrika
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Die waarde klim by elke stap
veranderings.rede: Attributive 'klaar' is colloquial; 'voltooide' is the standard written form and is within Grade 6 vocabulary.

veranderings.voor: klip met goud in uit die grond haal
veranderings.na: klip waarin goud sit, uit die grond haal
veranderings.rede: 'met goud in uit die grond' stacks two prepositions awkwardly; the relative clause reads smoothly and matches the rif entry.

veranderings.na: en die werk in die myn laat doen
veranderings.rede: 'sy' could refer to the business or the mine; naming the mine's work removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.
